name: MailerLite
description: MailerLite lets agents read subscribers, groups, campaigns, and automations, and draft campaigns in the signed-in MailerLite account. Each user signs in to their own MailerLite account through the browser.

prompts.text: Compare the open and click rates of my last five campaigns.
How many active subscribers are in each group?
Draft a newsletter about our new features, but do not send it.

apps.name: MailerLite
apps.description: Subscribers, groups, campaigns, and automations, over MailerLite's MCP server with browser sign-in.
